name: Tom Scott
hook: A jazz saxophonist who recorded his first album as a teenager, and whose solo became the horn line of 'T.R.O.Y.'.
blurb: Tom Scott is a saxophonist from Los Angeles. He recorded his first album, The Honeysuckle Breeze, for the jazz label Impulse! in 1967, when he was a teenager. One track, 'Today', is his easy-listening jazz version of a Jefferson Airplane song. In 1992 Pete Rock took parts of its saxophone solo and made them the main melody of 'They Reminisce Over You (T.R.O.Y.)', a hip-hop memorial for a dead friend, which shows how far a sample can travel. Scott went on to a long career as a session and jazz-fusion player. He is on the map as a much-sampled source (Q21).
